summary: Diatreme is a release/deployment orchestrator with two independent surfaces in one repo that communicate over HTTP. Surface 1: a GitHub Marketplace composite action (action.yml + scripts/*.sh) that runs semantic versioning, GitHub Releases, Docker image build/promote, image scanning + SBOM/finding routing, and promotion-PR automation. Surface 2: a Cloudflare Worker (worker/) that is the hosted GitHub App backend — an OIDC->installation-token broker and an App/bot-attributed commit/tag signer. Neither surface imports the other.
entrypoints: action.yml:runs (composite, 44 steps; modes: ci | release | enable-auto-merge)

action.purpose: The published composite action: 83 inputs, 10 outputs, ~2740 lines of inline bash orchestration that shells out to scripts/*.sh. mode=ci builds/pushes pr-<N> images (+ optional scan/SBOM); mode=release does versioning, GitHub Release, image promotion, promotion PRs; mode=enable-auto-merge flips native auto-merge on a PR.
exports: outputs: version, tag, is-prerelease, released, prerelease-identifier, resolved-environment, package-published, image-scanned, image-findings, resolved-image-name

auth.purpose: Centralized auth selection (auth-mode: public-app | github-token | app). request-public-app-token.sh exchanges the Actions OIDC token for a short-lived App installation token by calling the worker's /token broker.
exports: resolved token for downstream git/gh/registry auth

versioning.path: scripts/detect-versioning-tool.sh, scripts/run-python-semantic-release.sh, scripts/semantic-release-deps.sh, scripts/extract-semrel-plugins.mjs, scripts/force-bump-version.sh, scripts/push-release-tag.sh
versioning.purpose: Versioning backends and release-tag push. detect-versioning-tool.sh resolves the tool from repo markers when versioning-tool=auto (two-tier: release config wins, then ecosystem manifest). run-python-semantic-release.sh drives the pinned python-semantic-release CLI. force-bump-version.sh forces the next bump. semantic-release-deps.sh + extract-semrel-plugins.mjs install/resolve semantic-release (npm) plugins.

image.purpose: Docker image lifecycle. resolve-image-name.sh derives the image name (auto-detect or explicit). scan-image.sh runs Trivy on the assembled pr-<N> image. verify-promote-source.sh checks provenance labels (stamped by mode=ci) against the release commit's git tree before promoting; stale/unverifiable images are rebuilt instead of promoted.

sbom-sinks.purpose: Visibility-first, failure-isolated reporting sinks: CycloneDX SBOM -> Dependency-Track; optional findings -> DefectDojo. A scanner that cannot run is a build error; a sink that fails does not fail the build unless image-scan-gate.

packaging.purpose: Publishes language packages (nuget, npm, maven, gradle, rubygems, container, pip) to GitHub Packages or public registries, on github.com and GitHub Enterprise.

pr-automation.path: scripts/build-promotion-pr-body.sh, scripts/enable-auto-merge.sh, scripts/check-branch-naming.sh, scripts/append-github-projects.sh, scripts/move-github-projects.sh, scripts/append-clickup-tickets.sh
pr-automation.purpose: Promotion-PR body assembly, native auto-merge enablement, branch-naming gate (mode=ci), and aggregation of GitHub Projects items / ClickUp tickets into release notes + moving Projects cards on release.

worker.purpose: Cloudflare Worker GitHub App backend. /token: verify Actions OIDC (issuer-pinned via jose) -> mint short-lived App installation token (github.com or opt-in GHE tenant). /sign: mint installation token -> createCommitOnBranch (GitHub-signed, App/bot-attributed). /releases: Bearer-gated aggregate of latest releases across installations (KV-cached). /webhook: HMAC-verified push -> fast-forward open PRs (opt-in AUTO_UPDATE_BRANCHES).

workflows.purpose: ci.yaml validates both surfaces (actionlint, shellcheck, bats, psr pin smoke-test; worker typecheck+test). release.yaml dogfoods `uses: ./` to release the action and moves the floating major tag. deploy-worker.yaml ships worker/ to Cloudflare and injects the KV namespace id. security.yml runs the org Chargate gate.
exports: CI gates, action release, worker deploy

tests.purpose: 19 bats suites cover the shell scripts + action wiring (action-input-defaults, action-script-refs, detect-versioning-tool, force-bump, docker-promotion, verify-promote-source, resolve-*, publish-package, etc.). worker/test/index.test.ts (vitest, ~785 lines) covers the worker endpoints.

callgraph_highlights.note: Auth -> resolve versioning backend -> version -> push tag. Backend may instead be gitversion / release-please / semantic-release-npm.
Provenance-verify the pr-<N> image before promoting; rebuild from the release checkout if stale. Then assemble the promotion PR body.
Build+push pr-<N> image, then non-blocking scan -> SBOM/findings sinks (failure-isolated).
OIDC repo claim must equal owner/repo; ALLOWED_REPOSITORIES enforced; GHE issuer switches App + apiBase.
Bearer PROCESS_TRIGGER_SECRET gated; commit is GitHub-signed and App/bot-attributed.
Opt-in AUTO_UPDATE_BRANCHES; only push events act, all else acked as no-op.
